dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. I guess you've come here to talk about everything that's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Haw-haw... The supreme wisdom that connects the starry sky and the world below has revealed the future. These locations will be struck by stars falling from the sky. Precisely as the prophecy of Picatrix foresaw.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: They may only be predictions, but they should match the facts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Remind me what we need to do?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I will continue to calculate fate's trajectory concerning this incident. Something bigger is still to come.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: In the meantime, I need you to verify the that the predictions so far are accurate. The more diligent you are, the quicker this incident will come to its resolution.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Well, what else do you want to know?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Fate may be predetermined, but still... Good luck.
